about: Two unrelated conditions on one type (versioning, access logging) stay separate bullets: the joining rules (one condition, a mark-for-op set) mustn't over-merge.

controls.output:
- S3 buckets whose `Versioning.Status` isn't `Enabled` are flagged. Versioned buckets pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-versioning@1
- S3 buckets with access logging disabled are flagged. Buckets with logging on pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-access-logging@1
- S3 buckets without versioning (`Versioning.Status` not `Enabled`) or access logging are flagged. Buckets with both pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-versioning@1 acme:s3-access-logging@1

- S3 buckets without object history are flagged. Buckets keeping old objects pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-versioning@1
- S3 buckets that record nothing are flagged. Others pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:s3-access-logging@1
